name: How long does it take to install bi-fold patio doors?
description: Installation usually takes 1-3 days, but can be longer if structural modifications or new openings are required.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install bi-fold patio doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for bi-fold patio doors typically ranges from one to three days, depending on the complexity of the project, including any necessary structural modifications to the existing opening. If the project involves enlarging an existing opening or creating a new one, additional time will be required for framing and finishing work. Process clarity is achieved by our team providing a detailed project schedule during the initial consultation, ensuring you know what to expect during the installation phase in areas like Hayward or Fremont.
